facts.text: Meteorology Sensor Boom was deployed at Utopia Planitia during Viking 2 in 1976.

An upright 1.3-metre sensor mast equipped with hot-film anemometers, thermocouple temperature gauges, and a thin-diaphragm pressure transducer positioned to minimize thermal contamination from the lander's RTGs.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Measured the annual atmospheric pressure cycle as the Martian polar ice caps froze out and sublimated, revealing that 25% of Mars's atmosphere condenses each winter.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Utopia Planitia.
Its 4-year continuous barometric pressure record remains the fundamental baseline for global Martian atmospheric climate models.
